_about: Refining (Dan, 2026-11-02; Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `refiner: true` (a Refiner, a magical trade, not the smith). Each rank counts as +1 item level and the item's stats are worked out again by the item budget (docs/stats-and-damage.md); it extends the life of gear you already have, never makes one source of gear better than another. `caps` by rarity: how many ranks an item can take. `ranks` (one entry a rank, in order): coins, `chance` (percent to succeed), plus a count of each material named in `bands` (the first band whose `upToLevel` is at least the item's level before the rank: Gloamstone, Wyrdstone, Starsteel, Godsiron; their item ids keep the old dust names so saves still load), plus `coinsPerItemLevel` x level coins. A failed attempt only costs what was put in, never the item or a rank, and adds `resolvePerFail` percent to that item's next attempt (saved as rolls.resolve, cleared on success). From rank `announceFrom` a success is announced in the chat. An epic or legendary item's last rank (its cap) also needs `lastRank`. `scrap` breaks enhanced gear or better into `stones` of its band (a count by rarity) and `extra` for the rarities listed, gives back `refund` of every refining material put into it, and its gems; the window shows what you get first. Stones also fall from casters, soulshards from great beasts and bosses (loot_tables.json).
